title: Legacy program oral tradition of agreement with a third party

tellings.quote: I have learned that it is the oral tradition in the legacy program itself that agreements were struck between the United States and a third party

plain: Within the legacy programme, the name insiders use for a long-running secret US effort around non-human craft, there is said to be an oral tradition that the United States struck agreements with "a third party". Matthew Brown, a former Pentagon official who has come forward as a whistleblower, tells Michels he learned this, without naming who told him. If true, it would mean the US government made deals with someone outside any known nation.
